name: Luanti
hint: Luanti (formerly Minetest) voxel sandbox server, joined over IPv6

GAME.title: Game
GAME.description: Any game on content.luanti.org as author/name, for example ryvnf/mineclonia or Wuzzy/mineclone2 (VoxeLibre). It is downloaded on first start and used when the world is created.

WORLD_NAME.title: World name
WORLD_NAME.description: Changing it starts a new world. Change it too when you switch games.

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players join from Join Game in Luanti with the app's address and port 30000. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.

ADMIN_NAME.title: Admin player name
ADMIN_NAME.description: The player who joins with this name gets every privilege.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: New players must enter it the first time they join. Leave empty for an open server.
